_doc: Fighter traits (sys-traits). Crusader-Kings-style personality, physique and history traits; every name and text is original. Spec: docs/design/_drafts/03-fighter-lifecycle.md. Stat ids are the combat.json attribute ids (str agi pac tgh pre arc spi wil cmp ldr awr dis). Each effect's 'owner' (see effectTypes) says who applies it: 'management' effects are applied by lifecycle/economy code before or outside the fight (stat adds arrive in the fight setup's effective stats and must not be re-applied); 'sim' effects are applied inside the fight by combat (sys-fight-traits, combat.json traitEffectAdapter; docs/design/03 boundary contract 3). Whole-point stat adds are capped at +/-3 per stat per trait (statAddCapPerTrait, TUNABLE). effectText must be updated by whoever changes a number. Fractions are decimals; the loader converts them to basis points.
status: DRAFT 2026-10-25 (fighter-lifecycle designer). ~80/20 positive/negative is REQUIRED (O5); catalogue, weights, numbers and the roll algorithm are PROPOSED / TUNABLE.

rollRules._doc: Roll per generated fighter, generation stream STREAM.traits: (1) n from countWeights; (2) the fighter gets exactly one negative trait with probability negativeChancePerTrait * n (40% / 60% / 80% for 2 / 3 / 4 traits), otherwise none: ~20% of rolled traits are negative and no starting fighter has more than one; (3) roll the negative first (if any), then the positives, each a weighted pick among eligible traits of that polarity using rollWeight * raceWeight[race] (missing raceWeight = 1). If no eligible trait remains for a slot it stays empty (no polarity swap, so the one-negative cap always holds).
eligibility: neither trait lists the other in opposites or excludes (checked both ways)
not in the same exclusiveGroup as a held trait
rookieOnly traits only if humanAge <= rookieOnlyMaxHumanAge at generation

kinds.edge: net positive with a small drawback
kinds.burden: net negative with a real upside or niche
kinds.flaw: pure negative; every rolled flaw has a visible way to lose it (scars are flaws by design and permanent, O-ladder)

rarityBands._doc: Labels follow the expected share of generated fighters holding the trait (Monte Carlo over all races).
rarityBands.storied: never rolled; earned through events, captaincy or injury

revealOrder._doc: FUTURE (M4 scouting, P-12, research D3) hook; M1 shows every trait. Tier = the knowledge step that reveals the trait.

categories.name: Temperament
categories.description: How the fighter carries themselves: nerve, pride, sociability. Changes only through the events listed on each trait.

categories.name: Physique
categories.description: Born with it. Never gained after generation and never lost.

categories.name: Fighting Style
categories.description: Habits that show in the arena. Small in-fight modifiers only; never skip or reorder tactics rules (P-06).

categories.name: Mind & Discipline
categories.description: How the fighter learns, trains and ages.

categories.name: Acquired
categories.description: Earned or suffered during a career: veteran status, titles, captaincy, scars. Public record; does not count toward the 4 rolled traits.

effectTypes.description: Whole-point modifier to the effective attribute (|add| <= statAddCapPerTrait). Base stats are untouched; losing the trait removes it. Included in fight-setup stats.
Stat modifier applied to fight-setup stats only in matches of that competition type.
Multiplies the development-clock advance for the group while humanAge during the season is in range.
Multiplies wear accrued per season.
Looks up the decline table at humanAge - humanYears (positive = decline starts later).
Multiplies XP per round (floor after all multipliers).
Multiplies the strength of training emphasis effects (0 = emphasis has no effect).
Multiplies per-round injury chance (rolled by sys-injury after each round).
Multiplies injury weeks for severities that scale with recovery.
Multiplies scar chance on moderate and serious injuries.
Multiplies the season retirement chance.
Adds to captaincy (CQ 1-100).
Club-mates with humanAge <= 23 get this development multiplier (at most 2 trait mentors per club count; all mentoring capped at x1.15).
Adds to lineup chemistry while this fighter is fielded (sys-chemistry, applied as a fight-setup composure modifier).
Chemistry per other fielded fighter of the same race, capped; ifNone applies when there is none.
Applied once per unordered pair of fielded fighters that both hold withTrait.
Applied once per lineup if at least minHolders fielded fighters hold withTrait.
This fighter does not receive the lineup chemistry composure modifier, good or bad.
FUTURE (M3, P-07): changes the fighter rule-slot count, within 4..12.
Input for the league/economy designer (economy.json wage.traitAdj): fanAppeal (add), wageDemandMult (mult), loyalty (add).

effectTypes.params: when (always | selfHpBelow value | targetHpBelow value | openingSeconds seconds | afterSeconds seconds | allyDown seconds), mods {damageDealtMult | damageTakenMult | reactionDelayMult | composureAdd}
effectTypes.description: Conditional in-fight modifier, translated by combat.json traitEffectAdapter. Never skips or reorders rules (P-06). Trait-sourced in-fight mods are capped by combat.json derived.traitModCaps.
Enemies within the combat.json band get add composure.
Multiplies negative composure from Shaken and from allyDown-conditioned mods (0 = immune).
As acting captain, rally composure (truncated) and rally duration are multiplied.

traits.name: Still Water
traits.flavor: Nothing ripples the surface, not even a blade at the throat.
traits.effectText: +2 composure. Captaincy +3.

traits.name: Hot Blood
traits.flavor: Every cut is an insult, and insults get answered.
traits.effectText: -2 composure. Captaincy -8. In fights: +8% damage while below 50% HP. May mellow: 15% chance per season to lose it from human-age 30.

traits.name: Steel Spine
traits.flavor: Has watched friends fall before. Keeps swinging.
traits.effectText: +1 composure. Captaincy +3. In fights: unaffected by Shaken or by penalties when an ally is downed.

traits.name: Skittish
traits.flavor: Jumps at shadows, and at the sound of a friend hitting the sand.
traits.effectText: Captaincy -6. In fights: -3 composure for 4 s whenever an ally is downed. 50% chance to lose it on becoming Sand-Wise.

traits.name: Good Company
traits.flavor: Makes the long road between arenas feel shorter.
traits.effectText: +1 lineup chemistry while fielded. Captaincy +3.

traits.name: Prickly
traits.flavor: Trains alone, eats alone, and prefers it.
traits.effectText: -1 lineup chemistry while fielded. +8% XP. Captaincy -8.

traits.name: Glory-Hungry
traits.flavor: Wants their name sung in every taproom in the league.
traits.effectText: +15% XP. Retirement chance x0.8. -1 chemistry for each other Glory-Hungry fighter in the lineup. Captaincy -3. 50% chance to lose it on winning a title.

traits.name: Idle Hands
traits.flavor: Talented enough to get by, and knows it.
traits.effectText: Development x0.85. +1 lineup chemistry (easy to like). Retirement chance x1.2. Captaincy -5. 25% chance per season to lose it after a full season under a grade-A club captain in which they played at least half the time.

loss.requires: club captain grade A for the whole season and usage >= 0.5

traits.name: Showboat
traits.flavor: Fights for the crowd first and the lineup second.
traits.effectText: -1 composure. Captaincy -4. Fan appeal +1 (economy). In fights: +8% damage in the first 8 s of a round.

traits.name: Big-Stage Nerve
traits.flavor: The louder the crowd, the steadier the hands.
traits.effectText: +2 composure in tournament matches.

traits.name: Broad Frame
traits.flavor: Built like a doorway someone forgot to finish.
traits.effectText: +2 power, +1 durability, -1 speed.

traits.name: Whipcord
traits.flavor: Lean muscle wound tight as a bowstring.
traits.effectText: +1 speed, +1 finesse.

traits.name: Reed-Thin
traits.flavor: Hard to hit. Harder to keep standing.
traits.effectText: -2 durability, +1 finesse. Injury chance x1.15.

traits.name: Granite Bones
traits.flavor: The physicians complain about blunting their saws.
traits.effectText: Injury chance x0.75. Scar chance x0.7.

traits.name: Hollow Bones
traits.flavor: Light as a bird, and about as breakable.
traits.effectText: Injury chance x1.3, recovery time x1.15. +1 speed.

traits.name: Quick to Mend
traits.flavor: Sleeps off what lays others up for weeks.
traits.effectText: Injury recovery time x0.7.

traits.name: Slow to Mend
traits.flavor: Wounds linger like unpaid debts, but close clean.
traits.effectText: Injury recovery time x1.35. Scar chance x0.75.

traits.name: Needle Sight
traits.flavor: Can split a hanging thread at forty paces.
traits.effectText: +2 precision.

traits.name: Thick Hide
traits.flavor: Shrugs off blows that would fell a cart-horse.
traits.effectText: +2 durability.

traits.name: Bellows Chest
traits.flavor: Breathes like a forge and never seems to tire.
traits.effectText: In fights: +8% damage after 30 s of a round.

traits.name: Weathers Well
traits.flavor: Looks the same at forty as at twenty-five, and fights like it.
traits.effectText: Physical decline starts 2 human-years later. Retirement chance x0.85.

traits.name: Burns Fast
traits.flavor: Bright, quick, and gone before you've learned their name.
traits.effectText: Development x1.1. Physical decline starts 2 human-years earlier.

traits.name: Thunder Opener
traits.flavor: The first ten heartbeats of a round belong to them.
traits.effectText: In fights: +10% damage in the first 8 s of a round.

traits.name: Cold Starter
traits.flavor: Needs a few blows to wake up.
traits.effectText: In fights: -8% damage in the first 8 s of a round, +6% damage after 30 s.

traits.name: Hard to Put Down
traits.flavor: Keeps getting up. It's unsettling.
traits.effectText: In fights: -10% damage taken while below 30% HP.

traits.name: Pays It Back
traits.flavor: Hurt a friend and you've opened a debt.
traits.effectText: In fights: +10% damage for 5 s after an ally is downed.

traits.name: Smells Blood
traits.flavor: Knows the moment a foe starts to fold.
traits.effectText: In fights: +10% damage against targets below 25% HP.

traits.name: Guard-First
traits.flavor: Never forgets the shield arm, even mid-swing.
traits.effectText: In fights: -7% damage taken, -2% damage dealt.

traits.name: All Edge
traits.flavor: Defence is just a slower way to lose.
traits.effectText: In fights: +7% damage dealt, +9% damage taken.

traits.name: Flinches
traits.flavor: Blinks when the blade comes. Every time.
traits.effectText: -1 composure. In fights: reaction delay x1.06. 25% chance per season to lose it after a full season under a club captain of grade B or better in which they played at least half the time.

loss.requires: club captain grade B or better for the whole season and usage >= 0.5

traits.name: Heavy Hands
traits.flavor: Hits like a falling wall; aims like one too.
traits.effectText: +2 power, -2 finesse, -1 precision.

traits.name: Quick Study
traits.flavor: Watches a technique once and owns it by supper.
traits.effectText: Mental development x1.2. (From M3: +1 rule slot.)

traits.name: Regimented
traits.flavor: Same drills, same hour, every day for a decade.
traits.effectText: Training emphasis effects x1.5. +1 composure.

traits.name: Late Ripener
traits.flavor: Unremarkable at twenty. Unstoppable at twenty-eight.
traits.effectText: Development x0.85 before human-age 24, x1.35 from human-age 24 to 31.

traits.name: Early Spark
traits.flavor: Arrived nearly finished; the question is what's left to add.
traits.effectText: Development x1.25 before human-age 22, x0.85 from human-age 26.

traits.name: Student of the Sand
traits.flavor: Can tell you how every match this season was won, and why.
traits.effectText: +1 awareness. Mental development x1.1. (From M3: +1 rule slot.)

traits.name: Keeps the Edge
traits.flavor: Treats the body like a blade: honed daily, without mercy.
traits.effectText: Physical decline x0.75. Retirement chance x0.9.

traits.name: Wandering Mind
traits.flavor: Brilliant, briefly, about something else.
traits.effectText: -2 discipline. In fights: reaction delay x1.04. 25% chance per season to lose it after a season on Mind emphasis for at least half the matchweeks.

traits.name: Green Nerves
traits.flavor: Has never heard a crowd this loud.
traits.effectText: -3 composure. Captaincy -10. Fades after 120 career rounds (progress shown).

traits.name: Set in Their Ways
traits.flavor: Knows exactly how they fight, and won't hear otherwise.
traits.effectText: Training emphasis has no effect. Mental development x0.9. +1 composure.

traits.name: Rallying Voice
traits.flavor: Their shout carries over any crowd.
traits.effectText: Captaincy +12. As acting captain, in fights: rally composure and duration x1.5.

traits.name: Quiet Steel
traits.flavor: Rarely speaks; everyone listens when they do.
traits.effectText: Captaincy +6. +1 composure.

traits.name: Shares the Craft
traits.flavor: Never too busy to fix a youngster's footwork.
traits.effectText: Club-mates aged 23 or younger (human-age) develop x1.04. Captaincy +4.

traits.name: Kin-Bound
traits.flavor: Fights hardest beside their own blood.
traits.effectText: +1 lineup chemistry per other fielded fighter of the same race (max +2); -1 if there is none.

traits.name: Walks Alone
traits.flavor: Owes nothing to anyone in the line.
traits.effectText: Captaincy -15. Unaffected by lineup chemistry, good or bad. +1 composure.

traits.name: Sharp Tongue
traits.flavor: Always right, never thanked for it.
traits.effectText: -1 lineup chemistry while fielded. Captaincy -10. +1 awareness.

traits.name: Counts Every Coin
traits.flavor: Fights for the purse, and keeps a ledger of every bruise.
traits.effectText: Asks 15% more in wages (economy). Captaincy -4. +1 discipline.

traits.name: Crowd's Darling

traits.name: Sand-Wise
traits.flavor: Has seen every trick twice and fallen for none of them since.
traits.effectText: +1 composure, +1 awareness. Captaincy +4. (From M3: +1 rule slot.)

traits.name: Wore the Armband

traits.name: Title-Tested
traits.flavor: Has lifted silverware and wants the weight again.
traits.effectText: +1 composure. +1 lineup chemistry if two or more Title-Tested fighters are fielded (once per lineup).
